<style>
        .material-symbols-outlined {
            font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 0, 'wght' 400, 'GRAD' 0, 'opsz' 24;
        }
        body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background-color: var(--s-canvas); }
        h1, h2, h3 { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; }
        .home-fluid-b2 {
            overflow-x: hidden;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }
        .home-fluid-b2 header {
            box-shadow: 0 18px 54px rgba(0, 32, 26, 0.08);
        }
        .home-fluid-b2 main > section:not(:first-child) {
            position: relative;
        }
        .home-fluid-b2 #expertise {
            background:
                radial-gradient(circle at 22% 42%, rgba(0, 32, 26, 0.06), transparent 24rem),
                var(--s-soft);
        }
        .home-fluid-b2 #expertise [class*="w-80"][class*="h-80"] {
            filter: drop-shadow(0 28px 54px rgba(0, 32, 26, 0.12));
            animation: b-diagram-breathe 7s ease-in-out infinite;
            transform-origin: center;
        }
        .home-fluid-b2 #expertise svg path {
            transform-origin: center;
            animation: b-sector-enter 900ms ease both;
        }
        .home-fluid-b2 #expertise svg path:nth-of-type(2) { animation-delay: 120ms; }
        .home-fluid-b2 #expertise svg path:nth-of-type(3) { animation-delay: 240ms; }
        .home-fluid-b2 #expertise svg path:nth-of-type(4) { animation-delay: 360ms; }
        .home-fluid-b2 #expertise [class*="w-80"][class*="h-80"] > div.absolute:not(.inset-0) {
            box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(0, 32, 26, 0.13);
            transition: transform var(--s-duration) ease, box-shadow var(--s-duration) ease;
        }
        .home-fluid-b2 #expertise [class*="w-80"][class*="h-80"] > div.absolute:not(.inset-0):hover {
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.08);
            box-shadow: 0 24px 62px rgba(0, 32, 26, 0.18);
        }
        .home-fluid-b2 #expertise [class*="gap-y-16"] > div {
            transition: transform var(--s-duration) ease;
        }
        .home-fluid-b2 #expertise [class*="gap-y-16"] > div:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }
        .home-fluid-b2 #portfolio .grid > div {
            border-radius: var(--s-radius);
            box-shadow: 0 18px 58px rgba(0, 32, 26, 0.08);
            transition: transform var(--s-duration) cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow var(--s-duration) ease;
        }
        .home-fluid-b2 #portfolio .grid > div:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 34px 92px rgba(0, 32, 26, 0.15);
        }
        .home-fluid-b2 #portfolio img {
            transition-duration: var(--s-duration);
        }
        .home-fluid-b2 #portfolio .grid > div:hover img {
            filter: saturate(1.05) contrast(1.03);
        }
        .home-pillars-v3 #expertise [class*="w-80"][class*="h-80"] {
            --pillar-1: 1;
            --pillar-2: 1;
            --pillar-3: 1;
            --pillar-4: 1;
            --pillar-center: 1;
        }
        .home-pillars-v3 #expertise svg path {
            animation: none;
        }
        .home-pillars-v3 #expertise svg path:nth-of-type(1) {
            opacity: calc(0.16 + (var(--pillar-1) * 0.84)) !important;
            filter: blur(calc((1 - var(--pillar-1)) * 1px));
            transform: scale(calc(0.97 + (var(--pillar-1) * 0.03)));
        }
        .home-pillars-v3 #expertise svg path:nth-of-type(2) {
            opacity: calc(0.16 + (var(--pillar-2) * 0.84)) !important;
            filter: blur(calc((1 - var(--pillar-2)) * 1px));
            transform: scale(calc(0.97 + (var(--pillar-2) * 0.03)));
        }
        .home-pillars-v3 #expertise svg path:nth-of-type(3) {
            opacity: calc(0.16 + (var(--pillar-3) * 0.84)) !important;
            filter: blur(calc((1 - var(--pillar-3)) * 1px));
            transform: scale(calc(0.97 + (var(--pillar-3) * 0.03)));
        }
        .home-pillars-v3 #expertise svg path:nth-of-type(4) {
            opacity: calc(0.16 + (var(--pillar-4) * 0.84)) !important;
            filter: blur(calc((1 - var(--pillar-4)) * 1px));
            transform: scale(calc(0.97 + (var(--pillar-4) * 0.03)));
        }
        .home-pillars-v3 #expertise [class*="w-80"][class*="h-80"] > div.absolute:nth-of-type(1) {
            opacity: calc(0.18 + (var(--pillar-1) * 0.82)) !important;
            filter: blur(calc((1 - var(--pillar-1)) * 1.2px));
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(calc(0.92 + (var(--pillar-1) * 0.08))) !important;
        }
        .home-pillars-v3 #expertise [class*="w-80"][class*="h-80"] > div.absolute:nth-of-type(2) {
            opacity: calc(0.18 + (var(--pillar-2) * 0.82)) !important;
            filter: blur(calc((1 - var(--pillar-2)) * 1.2px));
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(calc(0.92 + (var(--pillar-2) * 0.08))) !important;
        }
        .home-pillars-v3 #expertise [class*="w-80"][class*="h-80"] > div.absolute:nth-of-type(3) {
            opacity: calc(0.18 + (var(--pillar-3) * 0.82)) !important;
            filter: blur(calc((1 - var(--pillar-3)) * 1.2px));
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(calc(0.92 + (var(--pillar-3) * 0.08))) !important;
        }
        .home-pillars-v3 #expertise [class*="w-80"][class*="h-80"] > div.absolute:nth-of-type(4) {
            opacity: calc(0.18 + (var(--pillar-4) * 0.82)) !important;
            filter: blur(calc((1 - var(--pillar-4)) * 1.2px));
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(calc(0.92 + (var(--pillar-4) * 0.08))) !important;
        }
        .home-pillars-v3 #expertise [class*="w-80"][class*="h-80"] > div.absolute:nth-of-type(5),
        .home-pillars-v3 #expertise svg circle {
            opacity: calc(0.28 + (var(--pillar-center) * 0.72)) !important;
        }
        @supports (animation-timeline: view()) {
            .home-fluid-b2 main > section:first-child > div,
            .home-fluid-b2 main > section:nth-of-type(2) > div,
            .home-fluid-b2 #expertise > div > .flex,
            .home-fluid-b2 #expertise [class*="gap-y-16"] > div,
            .home-fluid-b2 #portfolio .grid > div,
            .home-fluid-b2 #portfolio > div > .text-center,
            .home-fluid-b2 #portfolio > div > .flex,
            .home-fluid-b2 main > section:last-of-type > div {
                animation: b2-scroll-presence both;
                animation-timeline: view();
                animation-range: entry 0% exit 100%;
            }
            .home-fluid-b2 #expertise [class*="w-80"][class*="h-80"] {
                animation: b-diagram-breathe 7s ease-in-out infinite;
            }
            .home-fluid-b2 main > section:first-child > div,
            .home-fluid-b2 main > section:nth-of-type(2) > div,
            .home-fluid-b2 #expertise > div > .flex,
            .home-fluid-b2 #expertise [class*="gap-y-16"] > div,
            .home-fluid-b2 #portfolio .grid > div,
            .home-fluid-b2 #portfolio > div > .text-center,
            .home-fluid-b2 #portfolio > div > .flex,
            .home-fluid-b2 main > section:last-of-type > div {
                animation-timing-function: linear;
            }
        }
        @keyframes b2-scroll-presence {
            0% { opacity: 0.02; transform: translateY(42px) scale(0.985); }
            30% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
            60% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
            100% { opacity: 0.015; transform: translateY(-40px) scale(0.985); }
        }
        @keyframes b-sector-enter {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.92); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
        }
        @keyframes b-diagram-breathe {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-2px); }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .home-fluid-b2 *,
            .home-fluid-b2 *::before,
            .home-fluid-b2 *::after {
                animation: none !important;
                transition: none !important;
            }
        }
        .green-v2-premium main > section:first-child {
            background:
                radial-gradient(1200px circle at 18% 16%, rgba(20, 88, 73, 0.42), transparent 58%),
                radial-gradient(980px circle at 86% 18%, rgba(233, 193, 118, 0.08), transparent 54%),
                linear-gradient(155deg, var(--s-green) 0%, var(--s-green-deep) 100%) !important;
        }
        .green-v2-premium main > section:last-of-type:not(.advisory-section) {
            background:
                radial-gradient(1100px circle at 22% 12%, rgba(31, 101, 84, 0.24), transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(1000px circle at 82% 78%, rgba(0, 25, 20, 0.48), transparent 62%),
                linear-gradient(160deg, var(--s-green) 0%, var(--s-green-deep) 55%, var(--s-green-deep) 100%) !important;
        }
        .agenda-curtain-warm {
            --agenda-curtain-color: var(--s-gold);
            --agenda-curtain-bg-color: var(--s-green);
        }
        .agenda-curtain-link {
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            isolation: isolate;
        }
        .agenda-curtain-link:hover,
        .agenda-curtain-link:focus-visible {
            background-color: var(--s-gold-hover) !important;
        }
        .agenda-curtain-link::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: 0;
            background-color: var(--agenda-curtain-bg-color);
            clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0);
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: clip-path var(--s-duration) cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1);
            will-change: clip-path;
        }
        .agenda-curtain-link:focus-visible {
            outline: 2px solid var(--s-green);
            outline-offset: 3px;
        }
        .agenda-curtain {
            position: relative;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            z-index: 1;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            line-height: inherit;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .agenda-curtain__base,
        .agenda-curtain__fill {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .agenda-curtain__fill {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            color: var(--agenda-curtain-color);
            clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0);
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: clip-path var(--s-duration) cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1);
            will-change: clip-path;
        }
        .agenda-curtain-link:hover .agenda-curtain__fill,
        .agenda-curtain-link:focus-visible .agenda-curtain__fill {
            clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0);
        }
        .agenda-curtain-link:hover::before,
        .agenda-curtain-link:focus-visible::before {
            clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0);
        }
        .agenda-curtain-link:not(:hover):not(:focus-visible)::before,
        .agenda-curtain-link:not(:hover):not(:focus-visible) .agenda-curtain__fill {
            transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.64, 0, 0.36, 1);
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .agenda-curtain-link::before,
            .agenda-curtain__fill {
                transition: none;
            }
        }
        .cta-drawn-frame-link {
            --cta-button-frame-color: var(--s-gold);
            --cta-button-green: var(--s-green);
            background-color: transparent !important;
            color: var(--cta-button-frame-color) !important;
            border-radius: var(--s-radius);
            box-shadow: none !important;
        }
        .cta-drawn-frame-link:hover,
        .cta-drawn-frame-link:focus-visible {
            background-color: transparent !important;
            color: var(--cta-button-frame-color) !important;
        }
        .cta-drawn-frame-link::before {
            display: block;
            background-color: var(--cta-button-frame-color);
            clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0);
            transition: clip-path var(--s-duration) cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1);
        }
        .cta-drawn-frame-link .agenda-curtain__fill {
            display: inline-flex;
            color: var(--cta-button-green);
            clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0);
            transition: clip-path var(--s-duration) cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1);
        }
        .cta-drawn-frame-link:hover::before,
        .cta-drawn-frame-link:focus-visible::before,
        .cta-drawn-frame-link:hover .agenda-curtain__fill,
        .cta-drawn-frame-link:focus-visible .agenda-curtain__fill {
            clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0);
        }
        .cta-drawn-frame-link:not(:hover):not(:focus-visible)::before,
        .cta-drawn-frame-link:not(:hover):not(:focus-visible) .agenda-curtain__fill {
            transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.64, 0, 0.36, 1);
        }
        .cta-drawn-frame-link:focus-visible {
            outline-color: var(--cta-button-frame-color);
        }
        .cta-drawn-frame-line {
            position: absolute;
            z-index: 2;
            background-color: var(--cta-button-frame-color);
            opacity: 0.95;
            pointer-events: none;
            transition-duration: var(--s-fast);
            transition-property: transform;
            transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1);
            will-change: transform;
        }
        .cta-drawn-frame-line--top {
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 1.5px;
            transform: scaleX(1);
            transform-origin: left center;
        }
        .cta-drawn-frame-line--right {
            top: 0;
            right: 0;
            width: 1.5px;
            height: 100%;
            transform: scaleY(1);
            transform-origin: center top;
        }
        .cta-drawn-frame-line--bottom {
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 1.5px;
            transform: scaleX(1);
            transform-origin: right center;
        }
        .cta-drawn-frame-line--left {
            left: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 1.5px;
            height: 100%;
            transform: scaleY(1);
            transform-origin: center bottom;
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .cta-drawn-frame-link::before,
            .cta-drawn-frame-link .agenda-curtain__fill,
            .cta-drawn-frame-line {
                transition: none;
            }
        }
    </style>

    menu.addEventListener('click', event => {
        if (event.target.closest('a')) closeMenu();

    document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        if (event.key === 'Escape' && button.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') {
            closeMenu();
            button.focus();
        }
    });
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
        if (window.innerWidth >= 768) closeMenu();
    });
})();

<script>
(() => {
    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    const selectors = []; // Text stays readable; only the decorative diagram animates.
    const clamp = value => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, value));
    const smooth = value => {
        const progress = clamp(value);
        return progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress);
    };
    let items = [];
    let diagram;
    let ticking = false;

    const collect = () => {
        items = selectors.flatMap(selector => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector)));
        diagram = document.querySelector('#expertise [class*="w-80"][class*="h-80"]');
    };

    const reset = () => {
        items.forEach(element => {
            element.style.opacity = '';
            element.style.willChange = '';
        });
        if (diagram) {
            diagram.style.opacity = '';
            diagram.style.willChange = '';
            ['--pillar-1', '--pillar-2', '--pillar-3', '--pillar-4', '--pillar-center'].forEach(property => {
                diagram.style.removeProperty(property);
            });
        }
    };

    const update = () => {
        ticking = false;
        if (reduceMotion.matches) {
            reset();
            return;
        }

        const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
        const entryDistance = viewportHeight * 0.31;
        const exitDistance = viewportHeight * 0.42;
        const entryStart = viewportHeight * 0.99;
        const entryEnd = viewportHeight * 0.68;
        const exitStart = viewportHeight * 0.46;
        const exitEnd = viewportHeight * 0.04;

        items.forEach(element => {
            const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
            const entering = clamp((entryStart - rect.top) / entryDistance);
            const leaving = clamp((rect.bottom - exitEnd) / exitDistance);
            const rawPresence = Math.min(entering, leaving);
            const shapedPresence = rawPresence >= 0.995 ? 1 : Math.pow(rawPresence, 1.45);
            const presence = Math.max(0.015, shapedPresence);
            element.style.setProperty('opacity', presence.toFixed(3), 'important');
            element.style.willChange = 'opacity';
        });

        if (diagram) {
            const rect = diagram.getBoundingClientRect();
            const buildStart = viewportHeight * 0.98;
            const buildEnd = viewportHeight * 0.36;
            const buildProgress = clamp((buildStart - rect.top) / (buildStart - buildEnd));
            const values = [0, 0.11, 0.22, 0.33].map(offset => smooth((buildProgress - offset) / 0.46));
            const center = smooth((buildProgress - 0.18) / 0.46);
            const leaving = clamp((rect.bottom - exitEnd) / (viewportHeight * 0.54));
            const presence = buildProgress < 0.98 ? 1 : Math.max(0.015, Math.pow(leaving, 1.45));

            diagram.style.setProperty('opacity', presence.toFixed(3), 'important');
            diagram.style.willChange = 'opacity';
            diagram.style.setProperty('--pillar-1', values[0].toFixed(3));
            diagram.style.setProperty('--pillar-2', values[1].toFixed(3));
            diagram.style.setProperty('--pillar-3', values[2].toFixed(3));
            diagram.style.setProperty('--pillar-4', values[3].toFixed(3));
            diagram.style.setProperty('--pillar-center', center.toFixed(3));
        }
    };

    const schedule = () => {
        if (!ticking) {
            ticking = true;
            window.requestAnimationFrame(update);
        }
    };

    const init = () => {
        collect();
        update();
        window.addEventListener('scroll', schedule, { passive: true });
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            collect();
            schedule();
        });
        reduceMotion.addEventListener('change', schedule);
    };

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init, { once: true });
    } else {
        init();
    }
})();
</script>

<details open><summary>¿Qué hace Sollahms?</summary><p>Sollahms ofrece asesoría e información para evaluar oportunidades inmobiliarias en Chile. Conecta personas, empresas e inversionistas con activos y proyectos, y acompaña el análisis de ubicación, características y condiciones de cada alternativa.</p></details>
<details><summary>¿Cómo empiezo a invertir en propiedades?</summary><p>Comienza por definir tu objetivo, presupuesto, horizonte de inversión y necesidades de financiamiento. Después compara alternativas y confirma sus condiciones vigentes. En Sollahms puedes explorar proyectos y agendar una conversación para ordenar esa evaluación.</p></details>
<details><summary>¿Cómo pueden las propiedades aportar a la diversificación?</summary><p>Permiten incorporar exposición al mercado inmobiliario y evaluar distintas ubicaciones o tipos de activos. Comprar más de una propiedad no garantiza diversificación: importa cuánto concentra cada inversión y cómo se relacionan sus riesgos. Debes considerar liquidez, vacancia, gastos y financiamiento.</p></details>
<details><summary>¿Qué debo revisar antes de elegir un proyecto?</summary><p>Revisa la ubicación y conectividad, las características del inmueble, el estado y plazo de entrega, el precio, los gastos asociados y la disponibilidad. <details><summary>¿Está garantizado que una propiedad aumente mi patrimonio?</summary><p>No. El resultado depende del precio de compra, los costos, el financiamiento y la evolución del mercado, entre otros factores. Los arriendos, la plusvalía y la rentabilidad futura no están garantizados. La asesoría ayuda a evaluar antecedentes para decidir.</p></details>

El proyecto

El proyecto reúne estudios y departamentos de uno, dos y tres dormitorios. Incluye estacionamientos y bodegas, cuyas condiciones se consultan por separado.

Encuentra tu propiedad según tu renta

Explora un escenario de compra con tu renta, ahorro y un pie estimado. Puedes seguir usando el catálogo sin ingresar datos financieros.

Ingresa tu ahorro actual en pesos chilenos (CLP). Lo convertimos a UF con el valor oficial de hoy; no necesitas calcularlo. Si aún no tienes ahorro, puedes dejarlo en blanco.

Opcional, en pesos chilenos (CLP). Sumamos este aporte durante el horizonte de compra que elijas. Si lo dejas en blanco, consideramos $0.

No suponemos una tasa bancaria. Si dejas la tasa vacía, los proyectos quedarán pendientes de evaluación. El comparador permite consultar referencias sólo cuando coinciden con el escenario.

El presupuesto mensual es renta total × criterio − cuotas de deudas, con mínimo cero. 25% y 30% son criterios de exploración configurables; no son requisitos universales. Complementar renta depende de cada institución.

El dividendo incluye capital e intereses. Seguros y gastos están pendientes de verificación. El ahorro proyectado usa la UF fechada de hoy constante y no considera rentabilidad ni predice la UF futura.

Los resultados no representan aprobación ni probabilidad de crédito. La evaluación bancaria considera historial, antigüedad laboral, edad, deudas, seguros y el tipo de activo.

La búsqueda se calcula en tu navegador. No se guardan ni envían renta, deudas o ahorro. Al abrir un escenario sólo se conserva temporalmente el proyecto, monto, pie, plazo y tasa para el simulador.
